mapper.select: SELECT q.emp31_director_id AS director_id, q.emp31_person_id AS person_id, q.emp31_person_nm AS person_name, q.emp31_chn_nm AS chn_name, q.emp31_pos_nm AS pos_name, q.emp31_officer_yn AS officer_yn, q.emp31_ctz_no AS ctz_no, q.emp31_init_assign_date AS init_assign_date, q.emp31_rcnt_assing_date AS rcnt_assing_date, q.emp31_expire_date AS expire_date, q.emp31_assign_cnt AS assign_cnt, q.emp31_add_title AS add_title, q.emp31_qualified AS qualified, q.emp31_prefer_stock AS prefer_stock, q.emp31_common_stock AS common_stock, q.emp31_end_date AS end_date, q.emp31_end_reason AS end_reason, q.emp31_note AS note FROM () q

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp31_director ( emp31_director_id, emp31_person_id, emp31_init_assign_date, emp31_rcnt_assing_date, emp31_expire_date, emp31_assign_cnt , emp31_add_title, emp31_qualified, emp31_prefer_stock, emp31_common_stock, emp31_end_date, emp31_end_reason, emp31_note ) VALUES ( #{directorId}, #{personId}, #{initAssignDate}, #{rcntAssingDate}, #{expireDate}, #{assignCnt} , #{addTitle}, #{qualified}, #{preferStock}, #{commonStock}, #{endDate}, #{endReason}, #{note} )
mapper.update: UPDATE emp31_director SET emp31_init_assign_date = #{initAssignDate}, emp31_rcnt_assing_date = #{rcntAssingDate}, emp31_expire_date = #{expireDate}, emp31_assign_cnt = #{assignCnt}, emp31_add_title = #{addTitle}, emp31_qualified = #{qualified}, emp31_prefer_stock = #{preferStock}, emp31_common_stock = #{commonStock}, emp31_end_date = #{endDate}, emp31_end_reason = #{endReason}, emp31_note = #{note} WHERE emp31_director_id = #{directorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_string03, sys99_string04 , sys99_date01, sys99_date02, sys99_date03, sys99_long01 , sys99_string05, sys99_string06, sys99_string07, sys99_string08, sys99_string09, sys99_string10 , sys99_date04 ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , COALESCE(r.emp31_pos_nm, ''), COALESCE(r.emp31_person_nm, ''), COALESCE(r.emp31_chn_nm, ''), COALESCE(r.emp31_ctz_no, '') , r.emp31_init_assign_date, r.emp31_rcnt_assing_date, r.emp31_expire_date, COALESCE(r.emp31_assign_cnt, 0) , COALESCE(r.emp31_add_title, ''), COALESCE(r.emp31_qualified, ''), COALESCE(r.emp31_career, ''), COALESCE(r.emp31_note, '') , CASE WHEN r.emp31_officer_yn = 'true' THEN '등기' ELSE '비등기' END , CASE WHEN r.emp31_non_stay_yn IS NULL OR r.emp31_non_stay_yn != 'true' THEN '상임' ELSE '비상임' END , r.emp31_end_date FROM () r
